name: AWS Certified Developer - Associate
description: Validates a candidate's ability to demonstrate proficiency in developing, testing, deploying, and debugging AWS Cloud-based applications, including development with AWS services, security, deployment, and troubleshooting and optimization.

prerequisites: 1 or more years of hands-on experience developing and maintaining AWS applications
Proficiency in at least one high-level programming language
Experience using AWS service APIs, the AWS CLI, and SDKs
Experience using a CI/CD pipeline to deploy applications on AWS
